title: On a fractional nonlinear Schrödinger equation with irregular coefficients. case: d<2s
summary: In the case when $d<2s$, where $d$ is the space dimension and $s$ is the fractional power of the Laplacian, we study the well-posedness for a cubic nonlinear Schrödinger equation (CNLSE) generated by the fractional Laplacian and involving distributional, or less regular, coefficients. We formulate our problem in the setting of the concept of so-called very weak solutions and prove that it has a very weak solution.
